label: Synthetic demo
alt: A terminal running AutoPipeline 0.1.5's synthetic demo: eleven stage lines and DEMO PASS, then the monitor's text view with every stage Done or Skipped, then the start of the status JSON.
caption: Synthetic demo: AutoPipeline 0.1.5's first run in a terminal, drawn frame by frame from output captured on 21 October 2026 (package folder shortened to $AP_DIR). Made-up scroll, stand-in VC3D tools and a stand-in ink model, so its maps are not ink.
